The public API must use engine.logic through the supplied bridge. Repair both the implementation and its caller. Inputs must not be mutated. No test files are supplied. Required examples:

reference_patch.engine/logic.py:
def follow_alias(name, aliases):
    seen = set()
    while name in aliases:
        if name in seen: return None
        seen.add(name)
        name = aliases[name]
    return name

reference_patch.components/logic.py:
def compare_versions(left, right):
    a = [int(x) for x in left.split('.')]
    b = [int(x) for x in right.split('.')]
    n = max(len(a), len(b))
    a += [0] * (n-len(a))
    b += [0] * (n-len(b))
    return (a > b) - (a < b)

reference_patch.engine/logic.py:
def netstrings(text):
    out = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(text):
        colon = text.index(':', i)
        n = int(text[i:colon])
        start = colon + 1
        out.append(text[start:start+n])
        i = start+n+1
    return out

reference_patch.libcode/logic.py:
def token_bucket(capacity, refill, requests):
    tokens = capacity
    previous = 0
    out = []
    for time, amount in requests:
        tokens = min(capacity, tokens+(time-previous)*refill)
        accepted = amount <= tokens
        out.append(accepted)
        if accepted: tokens -= amount
        previous = time
    return out
